paragraphs.zh: Weitere kristallographische Daten der Kristallmodifikationen I und II von Tembotrione sind in Tabelle 7 angegeben.
paragraphs.en: Further crystallographic data of crystal modifications I and II of tembotrione are given in Table 7.
paragraphs.notes: Reassembled across a line break: 'ange-geben' in the two-column setting is one word, 'angegeben'.

Abbildung 3 zeigt das Raman-Spektrum der Kristallmodifikation III von Tembotrione. Die Werte der Bandenmaxima in Wellenzahlen sind in Tabelle 1 aufgeführt. paragraphs.en:
Description of the figures. Figure 1 shows the Raman spectrum of crystal modification I of tembotrione. The values of the band maxima in wavenumbers are listed in Table 1. Figure 1a shows the infrared spectrum of crystal modification I of tembotrione. The values of the band maxima in wavenumbers are listed in Table 2. Figure 2 shows the Raman spectrum of crystal modification II of tembotrione. The values of the band maxima in wavenumbers are listed in Table 1. Figure 2a shows the infrared spectrum of crystal modification II of tembotrione. The values of the band maxima in wavenumbers are listed in Table 2. Figure 3 shows the Raman spectrum of crystal modification III of tembotrione. The values of the band maxima in wavenumbers are listed in Table 1. Figure 3a shows the infrared spectrum of crystal modification III of tembotrione. The values of the band maxima in wavenumbers are listed in Table 2.

paragraphs.notes: Tabelle 1 is printed under a bare caption with no [00NN] marker of its own, so it is attached here to the nearest preceding numbered paragraph, [0018], per the shared briefing. The table as printed has SIX data columns under THREE headings, each heading spanning a pair of adjacent columns: 'Kristallmodifikation I' over columns 1 and 2, 'Kristallmodifikation II' over columns 3 and 4, 'Kristallmodifikation III' over columns 5 and 6. Within each pair the left column is the first half of that modification's ascending list of band maxima and the right column continues it, so the pair is one series read down the left column then down the right. GitHub markdown has no colspan, so the heading is repeated over both columns of each pair; the repetition marks the span and is not a duplicated column. The extracted text layer flattens all six columns row-major into a single run ('91, 921, 94, 976, 85, 867, ...') which destroys the number-to-modification association; the association here was read off the page image and the digits were then confirmed against the text layer. Column lengths differ because the columns are ragged at the foot: modification I has 30 + 30 values, II has 33 + 32, III has 39 + 39, 203 values on this page in total; empty cells in the lower rows are columns that have run out, not missing data. Tabelle 1 is NOT complete on this page: it continues on page 4 under '(fortgesetzt)'. Only the rows printed on page 3 are recorded here. In the printed paragraph the figure references 'Abbildung 1', 'Abbildung 1a', 'Abbildung 2', 'Abbildung 2a', 'Abbildung 3' and 'Abbildung 3a' are underlined; the underlining is not representable here and is not reproduced. 'Beschreibung der Abbildungen' is a heading run into the same paragraph as the body text, exactly as printed. Line-break hyphens were repaired when reassembling: 'Tem-botrione' to 'Tembotrione' and 'Banden-maxima' to 'Bandenmaxima'. The hyphens in 'Raman-Spektrum' and 'Infrarot-Spektrum' are real and were kept. The caption's unit is printed with a superscript minus one, 'cm' with superscript -1; it is recorded as 'cm-1' as the briefing directs.

notes: Page 3 of EP 2 045 236 A1, description. It carries two numbered paragraphs, [0017] and [0018] (the Beschreibung der Abbildungen), and then the start of Tabelle 1, 'Bandenmaxima der Raman-Spektren in [cm-1]'. COLUMN STRUCTURE, read off the page image: six data columns, grouped two by two under three headings, 'Kristallmodifikation I' over columns 1-2, 'Kristallmodifikation II' over columns 3-4, 'Kristallmodifikation III' over columns 5-6. Each pair is a single ascending series for that modification, continued from its left column into its right column. 39 body rows are printed on this page carrying 203 values in total (I: 30+30, II: 33+32, III: 39+39). The table continues on page 4 under '(fortgesetzt)', so these are only the rows printed on page 3. The table content is carried inside the zh and en of [0018] as a markdown table, per the briefing, because a table has no representation of its own downstream. 'drawings' is empty and that is a finding, not an omission: this page carries a numeric table and prose only, and no chemical structure and no reaction scheme. Nothing on this page is presented as prior art; it is descriptive matter of the application itself. The left margin carries the EPO line numbers 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50, 55 as typographic artifacts of the two-column setting; they are not content and are not transcribed. Digits were confirmed against the extracted text layer at /tmp/ep2045/page03.txt by rebuilding the row-major flat run from the six columns as read off the image and diffing it against the text layer; the two agree on all 203 values.
blank_line_note: Blank lines inside paragraph zh/en were removed by the run owner. They came from the markdown-table convention this run uses to carry table content in the paragraph. build_enriched.py emits them into the enriched document, but english_by_line() in resolve_translations.py builds its `body` with `if t.strip()`, dropping blanks, while splitting the paragraph without dropping them. Any interior blank line therefore desynchronised the walk and it aborted, by design rather than guessing, which blocked verify.py for the whole run. Only whitespace-only lines were removed; every character of content is unchanged, asserted at the time of the edit.
